correctness.rationale: PASS. The rank-one Nyström residual is PSD of rank one, so the preconditioned M has eigenvalues 1 and exp Z. Conditional independent Gaussian trace probing gives error Z(χ1²−1) and exact MSE=2 E Z². The determinant lemma expresses Z as log ratio of two diagonal angular quadratic forms; uniform Fourier expansions with radii u,v followed by orthogonality give E Z=m and Var Z=2[Li2(u²)+Li2(v²)−2Li2(uv)]. Ahat<=A and tr Ahat<=a force Z>=log(1+b), strictly if a>b almost surely; equality if a=b. For fixed b and contrast a→∞, Cauchy ratio s=√(b/a) ω2/ω1 and domination by logarithmic integrable envelope yield exact excess coefficient 8[log(1+b)+2 log 2] in units sqrt(b/a). Fresh independent high-precision angular quadrature/dilog comparisons at positive spectral pairs agree; proof covers continuum and limiting regime.

originality.rationale: PASS, best of knowledge. Saibaba et al. and Persson–Kressner address different logdet estimators or matrix-function approximation targets. The dilogarithmic exact two-eigenvalue risk and sharp square-root contrast penalty appear not to be directly implied by inspected results.
